http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

message.content:
Here are a few well‑known public APIs that accept an IP address (or domain name) and return detailed company‑level information—including contact details when available:

| Service | Key Features | Typical Response Fields | Free Tier / Pricing |
|---------|--------------|------------------------|---------------------|
| **ipinfo.io** | Provides company name, domain, ASN, and optional contact email/phone via the “company” field. | `org`, `hostname`, `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.type`, `company.phone`, `company.email` | 50k requests/month free; paid plans start at $5/mo |
| **ipstack.com** | Returns organization name, domain, and optionally the company’s phone/email if the “company” endpoint is enabled. | `organization`, `domain`, `company.name`, `company.phone`, `company.email` | 10k requests/month free; paid plans start at $9.99/mo |
| **ipapi.co** | Offers a “company” sub‑resource that gives company name, domain, and contact info. | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.phone`, `company.email` | 30k requests/month free; paid plans start at $9.99/mo |
| **ipgeolocation.io** | Provides company name, domain, and contact details via the “company” endpoint. | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.phone`, `company.email` | 100k requests/month free; paid plans start at $19/mo |
| **ipwhois.io** | Gives organization name, domain, and optional contact info. | `org`, `domain`, `company.name`, `company.phone`, `company.email` | 10k requests/month free; paid plans start at $5/mo |

### How to Use (Example with ipinfo.io)

```http
GET https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/company?token=YOUR_TOKEN
Accept: application/json
```

**Sample JSON Response**

```json
{
  "name": "Google LLC",
  "domain": "google.com",
  "type": "LLC",
  "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
  "email": "contact@google.com"
}
```

> **Note:**  
> - Some providers require you to enable the “company” feature in your account settings.  
> - Contact fields are only returned if the provider has them in its database; otherwise they’ll be omitted.

### Choosing the Right One

| Criteria | ipinfo.io | ipstack.com | ipapi.co | ipgeolocation.io | ipwhois.io |
|----------|-----------|-------------|----------|------------------|------------|
| **Free quota** | 50k | 10k | 30k | 100k | 10k |
| **Contact data availability** | Yes (via company endpoint) | Yes (optional) | Yes (optional) | Yes (optional) | Yes (optional) |
| **Ease of integration** | Simple REST + JSON | Simple REST + JSON | Simple REST + JSON | Simple REST + JSON | Simple REST + JSON |
| **Pricing for higher volume** | $5/mo | $9.99/mo | $9.99/mo | $19/mo | $5/mo |

If you’re just experimenting, the free tiers of **ipinfo.io** or **ipapi.co** should suffice. For production workloads, consider the paid plans that offer higher rate limits and guaranteed uptime.

Let me know if you’d like code snippets for a particular language or help setting up authentication!
